before.question: For normal author rules, an early layer has an ID selector and a later layer has a matching element selector. Which comparison comes first?
choices: Layer precedence, so the later layer wins
Specificity, so the ID always wins across layers
before.explanation: Normal layer precedence is considered before selector specificity. Specificity does not allow an earlier layer to jump above a later layer.

after.question: An earlier layer uses an ID selector and a later layer uses a matching element selector. For normal rules here, which wins?
choices: The later layer, because layer order is checked first
The ID always wins across layers
after.explanation: For these normal rules, layer order is checked before selector specificity.
